wikitext: {{Top|rwm|rofo|italics=1}} {{Otheruses|Allegiance}} {{ComicSeries |image=[[File:Allegiance_logo.jpg]] |title=''Star Wars: Allegiance'' |writer=[[Ethan Sacks]] |penciller=[[Luke Ross]] |inker=Luke Ross |letterer=[[Clayton Cowles]]{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/76701/journey_to_star_wars_the_rise_of_skywalker_-_allegiance_2019_1|text=Journey to Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Allegiance}} |colorist=[[Lee Loughridge]] |cover artist=[[Marco Checchetto]] |editor=[[Mark Paniccia]] |publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] |start date=[[October 9]], [[2019]]{{SW|url=news/journey-to-star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-publishing-program|text=Lucasfilm Unveils Complete 'Journey to Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker' Publishing Program - Exclusive}} |end date=[[October 30]], 2019 |schedule=Weekly |format=Miniseries |issues=4 |timeline=[[34 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars: Allegiance''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Ethan Sacks]] and illustrated by [[Luke Ross]].
